description: Complete Feedback Board UI: FeedbackBoard page with post cards, voting, search, filters, sorting, pagination; PostDetail page with full post view and admin status controls; CreatePost and EditPost pages; all reusable components (PostCard, VoteButton, StatusBadge, CategoryTag, SearchBar, FilterBar, Pagination) with optimistic UI for voting
steps: 1. Create client/src/components/CategoryTag.jsx - Accepts category prop (feature/bug/improvement), renders styled span with appropriate color (e.g., blue for feature, red for bug, yellow for improvement), Tailwind classes

2. Create client/src/components/StatusBadge.jsx - Accepts status prop (open/planned/in-progress/shipped), renders styled span with appropriate color (gray for open, blue for planned, yellow for in-progress, green for shipped)

3. Create client/src/components/VoteButton.jsx - Accepts postId, initialVoteCount, initialHasVoted, onVoteChange callback. Local state: voteCount (init from prop), hasVoted (init from prop). On click: optimistically update local state (toggle hasVoted, increment/decrement voteCount), call POST /api/posts/:postId/vote via axios, on success: call onVoteChange with new values from response, on error: rollback local state to previous values and show error message. Render button with up arrow or icon, vote count, highlight if hasVoted, disabled during loading

4. Create client/src/components/PostCard.jsx - Accepts post object and onVoteChange callback. Render card with: CategoryTag, StatusBadge, title (link to /posts/:id), truncated description, author name, VoteButton (pass post.id, post.voteCount, post.hasVoted, onVoteChange), timestamp. Styled with Tailwind, responsive, hover effects
5. Create client/src/components/SearchBar.jsx - Controlled input for search query, accepts value, onChange, onSubmit props. Form with text input and search button or on Enter. Styled with Tailwind

6. Create client/src/components/FilterBar.jsx - Dropdowns/buttons for category (All, Feature, Bug, Improvement) and status (All, Open, Planned, In Progress, Shipped). Accepts selectedCategory, selectedStatus, onCategoryChange, onStatusChange props. Styled with Tailwind, responsive (stacked on mobile)

7. Create client/src/components/Pagination.jsx - Accepts currentPage, totalPages, onPageChange props. Render Previous button, page numbers (show subset if many pages), Next button. Disable appropriately. Styled with Tailwind

8. Create client/src/pages/FeedbackBoard.jsx - State: posts array, loading, error, searchQuery, selectedCategory, selectedStatus, sortBy (top/newest), currentPage. On mount and when filters/search/sort/page change: fetch GET /api/posts with query params. Render SearchBar, FilterBar (category, status), sort toggle buttons (Top/Newest), posts.map(post => PostCard with onVoteChange that updates post in local state), Pagination, LoadingSpinner, ErrorMessage, empty state if no posts. When user votes, update the post's voteCount and hasVoted in local state without refetching

9. Create client/src/pages/PostDetail.jsx - Use useParams to get postId. State: post, loading, error. On mount: fetch GET /api/posts/:id. Render full post: title, CategoryTag, StatusBadge, description, author, VoteButton, timestamp. If adminReply exists, show in styled box. If current user is admin: show status dropdown (open, planned, in-progress, shipped) and adminReply textarea, Save button to PATCH /api/posts/:id/status. If current user is post author: show Edit and Delete buttons. Edit navigates to /posts/:id/edit, Delete calls DELETE /api/posts/:id and redirects to /. Handle vote with onVoteChange updating local post state

10. Create client/src/pages/CreatePost.jsx - Protected route. Form with title, description, category dropdown. On submit: POST /api/posts via axios with form data, on success navigate to /posts/:newPostId or /. Show loading, errors, validation

11. Create client/src/pages/EditPost.jsx - Protected route. Use useParams to get postId. On mount: fetch post, verify current user is author (if not, redirect or show error). Prepopulate form with post data. On submit: PUT /api/posts/:id, on success navigate to /posts/:id. Show loading, errors
12. Update client/src/App.jsx to include routes for / (FeedbackBoard), /posts/create (CreatePost, protected), /posts/:id (PostDetail), /posts/:id/edit (EditPost, protected)
acceptance_criteria: FeedbackBoard page displays posts as cards with vote buttons, category tags, status badges
Search bar filters posts by title/description
Category and status filters work correctly
Sort toggle switches between Top (by votes) and Newest (by date)
Voting on FeedbackBoard updates optimistically and syncs with backend
If vote fails, UI rolls back to previous state and shows error
PostDetail page shows full post with all details
Admin users see status dropdown and adminReply textarea on PostDetail
Non-admin users do not see admin controls
Post author sees Edit and Delete buttons on PostDetail
CreatePost page creates new post and redirects
EditPost page updates post if user is author, otherwise redirects
All components are responsive and styled with Tailwind
verification: Ensure backend and frontend are running
Open http://localhost:5173 - should show FeedbackBoard with sample posts
Test search: type keyword, press Enter - posts should filter
Test category filter: select Feature - only feature posts show
Test status filter: select Planned - only planned posts show
Test sort: click Top - posts order by voteCount; click Newest - posts order by date
Test pagination: click Next - should load next page
Test voting: click vote button - count increments, button highlights, state persists on page change and back
Test voting error: stop backend, try to vote - should show error and rollback UI
Click on post card - should navigate to PostDetail
On PostDetail: verify full post displays with vote button
Login as admin, view post detail - should see status dropdown and adminReply textarea
Change status and add admin reply, save - should update post
Login as post author, view post - should see Edit and Delete buttons
Click Edit - should navigate to EditPost with prepopulated form
Update post, save - should redirect to PostDetail with updated data
Click Delete - should delete post and redirect to home
Test CreatePost: click Create Post in navbar, fill form, submit - should create post and redirect
Verify all pages are responsive on mobile view (toggle browser dev tools)
